proto_guyy: In Lindenbruck, Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was a medical student. In R-F14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy answered the first call, number 69 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
rei0_shi4: The new rifleman is Severin "Lucky" Shi, once a coal miner from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Severin "Lucky" Shi said he would find out.
